source.snapshot_method: Structured from Tencent Cloud official documentation page

notes: The official page lists 48 unique VoiceType values.
All 48 appear in realtime and basic synthesis lists.
31 appear in the long-text synthesis list.
For VoiceType 501000-501007, the official page labels realtime as 中英文 but basic/long-text as 中文; endpoint-specific profiles preserve that difference.
gender_or_role is derived only from the official recommended_scene label.
Voice availability, billing tier, and resource-package coverage can change; refresh this snapshot when Tencent Cloud updates the source page.
